title: Smarter Sanity Studio v2
description: Upgrade the Sanity Studio to a smarter, more automated CMS by consolidating duplicate schemas, removing the skills plugin, adding migration scripts, improving presentation tool integration, and deploying a cleaner studio.
background: The current Sanity Studio has accumulated duplicate data models (heroSection vs profile both have fullName, title, email, location), a skills tool plugin that loads 42 markdown files at build time but is not used in production, and no automated migration scripts. The goal is to consolidate, simplify, and automate — making the studio easier to maintain and the content easier to manage.
constraints: Existing published data in Sanity must NOT be lost — all migrations are additive or transform in-place
No breaking changes to the live site data flow until migration scripts are verified
Each epic is committed as a separate slice
All migrations must be idempotent (safe to run multiple times)
The studio must remain deployable to Sanity Hosting after each epic

epics.title: Audit & Inventory
epics.description: Document the current state of all schemas, plugins, components, and data. Identify duplicates, unused fields, and migration risks.

epics.title: Schema Consolidation
epics.description: Merge heroSection + profile into a single profile singleton. Consolidate overlapping fields. Keep all existing data via migration scripts.

epics.title: Remove Skills Plugin
epics.description: Remove the skillsToolPlugin from the studio. Skills are already mirrored in .agents/skills/. The plugin adds build-time weight and is not used in production.

epics.title: Migration Scripts
epics.description: Create a scripts/sanity-migrate/ directory with idempotent migration scripts for all schema changes. Each script logs what it does, is dry-runnable, and can be rolled back.

epics.title: Presentation & UX Upgrade
epics.description: Improve the Presentation tool integration, add better preview locations, improve the desk structure, and polish the onboarding flow.

epics.title: Automation & Deploy
epics.description: Add CI/CD checks for schema validation, automated data health reports, and a clean deploy pipeline. Remove unused scripts.

dataPreservation.strategy: All migrations are additive or transform in-place. Original fields are kept as hidden/legacy until migration is verified. Rollback scripts restore original state.
riskFields: heroSection.heroRoles -> profile.heroRoles (array of strings, safe merge)
profile.education[].gpa -> keep but hide (user wants GWA hidden but data preserved)
safeFields: All collection documents (project, experience, certification, post, etc.) - no schema changes

successCriteria: Studio deploys to Sanity Hosting without errors
All existing published data is accessible after migration
No duplicate schemas (heroSection + profile merged into one)
Skills plugin removed, .agents/skills/ remains the source of truth
Migration scripts are idempotent and dry-runnable
Live site data flow unchanged (same GROQ queries, same components)
